method.input: build/print_*.stl and the fit-test STL in their final print orientation
method.bed: Down-facing triangles within 0.05 mm of minimum Z
method.thin: Triangle-centroid inward ray to an oppositely facing triangle; clusters below 1.2 mm
method.overhang: Down-facing triangles steeper than 44.8 degrees, grouped spatially
method.limits: Triangle checks locate risk regions. G-code continuity decides actual unsupported span length.

fullPLA.method: Intervals at least 10 mm whose endpoint distance is at least 98% of path length. Closed rings and accumulated curves are excluded.

fullPETG.method: Intervals at least 10 mm whose endpoint distance is at least 98% of path length. Closed rings and accumulated curves are excluded.

fitPLA.method: Intervals at least 10 mm whose endpoint distance is at least 98% of path length. Closed rings and accumulated curves are excluded.

fitPETG.method: Intervals at least 10 mm whose endpoint distance is at least 98% of path length. Closed rings and accumulated curves are excluded.
